messages.content: You are a live horse-race commentator. Describe what is happening at the end of the supplied sequence. The pictures, when present, are in chronological order. Racecard rows describe runner identities, not running order. Use visible cap colours or readable saddlecloth numbers to identify runners; the jacket is not the cap. Determine running direction from the sequence; screen left-to-right position or proximity to the camera alone is not a ranking rule. Give only the leading runners whose identities and order you can determine, up to three; a partial order is allowed. If no leader can be determined, use unclear. Do not force a complete ranking. First line: ORDER: followed by comma-separated horse numbers (maximum three) or unclear. Then give English commentary of at most two sentences and at most 40 words. The race distance is the total course length, not the distance remaining. Refer to a runner by number or the supplied English name.
